title: [29.x]-Purchase Credit Memo – "Get Return Shipment Lines" fails for Non-Inventory items with "corrective credit memo can only reverse the original posted invoice" error (regression from Bug 636861)
summary: Using 'Get Return Shipment Lines' on a purchase credit memo no longer fails for non-inventory items with the error that a corrective credit memo can only reverse the original posted invoice. This fixes a regression introduced by Bug 636861.
key_points: 'Get Return Shipment Lines' on purchase credit memos works again for non-inventory items
Removes the wrongly raised 'corrective credit memo can only reverse the original posted invoice' error
Fixes a regression introduced by the fix for Bug 636861
The Purchase Line table is changed in W1 and all country layers
Tests added to O365 Correct Purchase Invoice in several layers
